notes: Asset version must match ASSET_VERSION in view/oxidns/cmeditor.js.
Hashes are sha384 values computed from the files shipped in this directory and are also embedded in cmeditor.js as integrity attributes.
active-line.js is intentionally not vendored; styleActiveLine stays disabled so the editor never requests a missing asset.
If an asset fails to load (missing file or SRI mismatch), cmeditor.js falls back to the original textarea.
